name: Tousho Nanase
source:
Element: Nitrogen
Rank: 純参位
Hobby/Skill: Sleep

A boy who closed his heart and only does what he is ordered without using any feelings. Despite being a closed mind, he only shows his love and trust to Eito, and at the same time, a strong attachment.
